description: Faithful reproduction of Ref A (lightningv08 0.681) with only the 3-row public-sample preview shortcut removed.

compat_edits.new: preview = False  # engs108: the source's fingerprint-matched 3-row CPU preview (constant 'claude-fable-5' output) is disabled; every input runs the full pipeline
compat_edits.why: The source writes a constant 3-row placeholder when test.csv is exactly the public sample; the user requires no 3-row-stub paths.

map_input_layout_why: Ref A hardcodes a mix of flat (/kaggle/input/<slug>) and nested (/kaggle/input/datasets/<owner>/<slug>, /kaggle/input/competitions/name-that-llm) paths; our GPU session mounted the flat layout and a CPU session the nested one. An IPython input transformer rewrites paths to the mounted layout; no logic changes.
